name: transport-api
description: Production-ready REST API for public transport data in Dakar, Senegal. Part of the Dakar Mobility platform.

scripts.init-db: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const { Pool } = require('pg'); require('dotenv').config(); const pool = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL, ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false } }); const schema = fs.readFileSync('./src/database/schema.sql', 'utf8'); pool.query(schema).then(() => { console.log('Schema initialized successfully'); const seed = fs.readFileSync('./src/database/seed.sql', 'utf8'); return pool.query(seed); }).then(() => { console.log('Seed data inserted successfully'); pool.end(); }).catch(err => { console.error('Database initialization failed:', err.message); pool.end(); process.exit(1); });"
